title: in my dreams i still live at my parents' house. i thoght my brain just hadnt caught up. but i noticed another consistency.
content: so i moved to a disability support house a few years ago (i have autism tourettes & OCD). but in my dreams, i still live at my parents' house 15 minutes away. i assumed my brain just hadnt caught up to reality due to the fact i lived in my parents' house since i was born (im 32 years old). but i just had another dream last night, and just like in a few previous dreams, my brother lives in a lil shack across the alley from my parents' house. his shack in my dreams has cool mechanical stuff built into it like a weird door that leads into the basement thru a tunnel. ***in real life my brother lives in a different province!!*** but it seems to be consistent in my dreams that he lives across the alley from my parents. so i guess i miiiiight mayb have a persistent dream world thats an alternate version of reality? _i will admit that last night's dream wasnt very realistic. in it, Rocco Botte from the youtube comedy group Mega64 came to my house and i rode my dad's office computer chair into the sky becuz it had a little jet engine on it that made it fly. so mayb some aspects of my persistent dream world arent very realistic._
